dissents.reason: LMT fails my trend filter because its 26-week channel falls 43% a year and its weekly MACD line is still below zero, so sitting 2.4 widths above that falling line is a counter-trend rally in a downtrend, not a pullback in a rising channel.

TMO does not qualify because its 26-week channel still slopes down (4% a year), and after a +6.7% week it sits 2.0 widths above that line, so even with a positive weekly MACD this is chasing a stretched bounce rather than buying a pullback in a rising channel.
